- Add ThinkNode M9 Standalone support, with keyboard navigation, LoRa, WiFi, GNSS and sound. RNode support is coming soon.
- Show two chats per page on every handheld, with simpler page controls and message previews.
- Load chats faster and update recent activity automatically.
- Fix the Ratspeak Hub preset so WiFi connections can discover peers correctly.
- Simplify Settings and the empty Contacts screen.

All handheld firmware is beta. Cardputer requires a Cap LoRa-1262 with an antenna for LoRa.

Factory ZIP installs erase settings, identity and internal message history. Back up anything you want to keep before installing.
